reviews.text: A fully accessible guitar tuner!. As a totally blind musician, I've been looking for a tuner that is accessible with Voiceover. Your Acoustic Tuner app fits the bill! I purposefully didn't allow access to the microphone, because my ear is all I need! And everything is accurately labeled and clearly spoken by Voiceover! I highly recommend that blind and visually impaired musicians get this app!
Best Tuner!!!. This is the best of all tuners I have tried!! Seriously even the top guitar brands are no where near as easy fun and efficient!! Do It!! LETS GO!!!

Simple. When I hold my phone against my guitar and use this tuner the wavelengths are incredibly easy to hear, even with the messed up hearing that I have. Instead of lining up visual effects to tune, a natural waveform is created that produces very accurate results when you hear it against the pitch of the string. Easy.

Don Deo, (Mister Fingers). This helps the player to tune its ear. The ultimate goal is to make the best tune without no help just the sound in your mind. I saw this talent in a old man who constructed acoustic guitars and after a long time making them and in a rush for a musician who needed one he lost his left hand fingers only the thumb was left after passing a piece of beautiful wood on a desk rotary saw. After that tragic event, people thought that it was it for Don Deo, but we were wrong he kept making beautiful guitars and when he was finish with one he tune the guitar amazingly only by ear.

Truth story by US Army retired SFC Aponte Alfredo
